blocks.markdown:
## What the hero worked out for itself

The count in the ink block is the number of sections below the hero. The stamp is this post's date and its first subject. The ruler has one segment per section, each as long as the section has content, and closes on the year and the number of plates on the page. The note under the count is the portrait's caption.

None of it is typed into the document: change the page and the hero follows.
